consumer: The salvage contract's mission/condition completion check asking 'is all the required scrap gathered yet?'
scope: The engine's charge-aware item count over the contract's required scope (the reachable/required inventory it counts, e.g. player inventory plus the delivery zone), not just nearby map tiles
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(items) — it serializes raw map::i_at(p) ground-item stacks for tiles inside the export window, exposing partial simulation state (S) rather than computing the contract's completion predicate
divergence: The required scrap is in the player's backpack (or a container/just outside the export radius): the contract is actually complete, but the tile-stack snapshot reports no loose scrap on the ground and the UI shows it as not-there-yet (and count_by_charges/stacking differences mis-tally partial-charge scrap)
